prompt: Create an original 90 second chamber classical instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 86 BPM; G major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A lively and elegant classical-style waltz featuring a prominent melody played by strings and woodwinds, supported by a rhythmic piano accompaniment. The piece has a graceful and somewhat whimsical character.
description.zh: 一首活泼优雅的古典风格华尔兹，以弦乐和木管乐器演奏的突出旋律为主，并辅以富有节奏感的钢琴伴奏。这首曲子具有优美而略带异想天开的特色。
